name: Pelleas

attributes.attribute: also called Pelles, related to the Fisher King

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Pelleas is another name for Pelles, the guardian of the holy cup. The reader is sent to the fuller FISHER KING entry. The name Pelleas is tied to the same cycle of knights who sought the cup.

okr.objective: Route the reader from Pelleas to the fuller Fisher King entry.
key_results: Identify Pelleas as another name for Pelles
